stories.title: Security guard electrocuted after power cable snaps in Tirunindravur
takeaways: A 55-year-old security guard died after touching a live snapped power cable near Avadi.
The tragic accident highlights urgent electrical safety concerns during monsoon weather.

stories.title: Okkiyam Maduvu Project To Be Major Gamechanger For S. Chennai
takeaways: The Okkiyam Maduvu project aims to prevent severe flooding across South Chennai.
Improved drainage infrastructure will reduce vehicle parking on flyovers during heavy monsoons.

stories.title: AI Framework Reads Lung Tumors With Unusual Precision on CT Scans
takeaways: A new artificial intelligence framework successfully reads lung tumors with high precision on CT scans.
This technological advancement promises to significantly improve early cancer detection rates worldwide.
